records.question: Which driver won the 2023 Monaco Grand Prix? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_result WHERE session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Monaco%' AND year = 2023 AND session_code = 'R') AND position = 1

records.question: Who took pole position for the 2024 Japanese Grand Prix? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_result WHERE session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Japanese%' AND year = 2024 AND session_code = 'Q') AND position = 1

records.question: Which team did Lewis Hamilton drive for in the 2025 Canadian Grand Prix? Give the team name.
records.sql: SELECT team_name FROM fct_result WHERE driver_code = 'HAM' AND session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Canadian%' AND year = 2025 AND session_code = 'R');

records.question: Where did Oscar Piastri start the 2025 Austrian Grand Prix? Give the grid position.
records.sql: SELECT f.grid_position FROM fct_result f JOIN dim_driver d ON f.driver_id = d.driver_id JOIN dim_session s ON f.session_key = s.session_key WHERE d.full_name = 'Oscar Piastri' AND s.event ILIKE '%Austrian%' AND s.year = 2025 AND s.session_code = 'R';

records.question: On which circuit was the 2025 Japanese Grand Prix run? Give the circuit name.
records.sql: SELECT circuit_name FROM dim_session_circuit WHERE event ILIKE '%Japanese%' AND year = 2025;

records.question: How many laps did Fernando Alonso complete in the 2024 Spanish Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS laps_completed FROM fct_lap AS lap JOIN dim_driver AS driver ON lap.driver_code = driver.driver_code JOIN dim_session AS session ON lap.session_key = session.session_key WHERE driver.full_name = 'Fernando Alonso' AND session.event ILIKE '%Spanish Grand Prix%' AND session.year = 2024 AND lap.session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many Grands Prix did Max Verstappen win in 2023?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS grand_prix_wins FROM fct_result AS fr JOIN dim_driver AS dd ON fr.driver_id = dd.driver_id JOIN dim_session AS ds ON fr.session_key = ds.session_key WHERE dd.driver_code = 'VER' AND ds.year = 2023 AND fr.position = 1 AND ds.session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many races were run in the 2019 season?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2019 AND session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many podium finishes did Lewis Hamilton have in 2021?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS podium_finishes FROM fct_result AS fr JOIN dim_driver AS dd ON fr.driver_id = dd.driver_id JOIN dim_session AS ds ON fr.session_key = ds.session_key WHERE dd.full_name = 'Lewis Hamilton' AND ds.year = 2021 AND fr.position <= 3 AND ds.session_code = 'R';

records.question: Which driver won the most Grands Prix in 2022? Give the driver id.
records.sql: SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) AS gp_wins FROM fct_result WHERE session_key LIKE '2022-R%' AND position = 1 GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY gp_wins DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which driver has won the most British Grands Prix? Give the driver id.
records.sql: SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM fct_result JOIN dim_session ON fct_result.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE dim_session.event ILIKE '%British%' AND fct_result.position = 1 GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 1;

records.question: Who won the 1994 drivers' championship? Give the driver id.
records.sql: SELECT driver_id FROM fct_driver_standing WHERE season = 1994 ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Which constructor won the 2010 constructors' championship? Give the constructor id.
records.sql: SELECT constructor_id FROM fct_constructor_standing WHERE season = 2010 ORDER BY points DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Who set the fastest race lap of the 2024 Italian Grand Prix, and what was the time in seconds? Ignore deleted laps.
records.sql: SELECT fct_lap.driver_code, MIN(fct_lap.lap_time_s) AS fastest_lap_time_s FROM fct_lap JOIN dim_session ON fct_lap.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE fct_lap.year = 2024 AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Italian%' AND fct_lap.session_code = 'R' AND fct_lap.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY fct_lap.driver_code ORDER BY fastest_lap_time_s ASC LIMIT 1
errors: Binder Error: Referenced column "event" not found in FROM clause!

records.question: How many laps long was the 2024 Bahrain Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT dl.ref_length_m / dl.laps_used AS lap_length_m FROM dim_session ds JOIN dim_session_circuit dsc ON ds.session_key = dsc.session_key JOIN dim_layout_length dl ON dsc.circuit_layout_key = dl.circuit_layout_key WHERE ds.year = 2024 AND ds.event ILIKE '%Bahrain%' AND ds.session_code = 'R';

records.question: Who led the 2025 Spanish Grand Prix race at the end of lap 30? Give the three-letter driver code.
records.sql: SELECT driver_code FROM fct_lap_gap WHERE year = 2025 AND session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM dim_session WHERE event ILIKE '%Spanish Grand Prix%' AND session_code = 'R') AND lap_number = 30 ORDER BY position LIMIT 1

records.question: How many pit stops did Charles Leclerc make in the 2025 Monaco Grand Prix race?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pit_stops FROM fct_pit_stop ps JOIN dim_driver d ON ps.driver_code = d.driver_code JOIN dim_session s ON ps.session_key = s.session_key WHERE d.full_name = 'Charles Leclerc' AND s.year = 2025 AND s.event ILIKE '%Monaco%' AND s.session_code = 'R';

records.question: How many purple sectors did Lando Norris set in 2024 Belgian Grand Prix qualifying?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS purple_sectors FROM fct_lap_sector JOIN dim_session ON fct_lap_sector.session_key = dim_session.session_key WHERE dim_session.year = 2024 AND dim_session.event ILIKE '%Belgian%' AND dim_session.session_code = 'Q' AND fct_lap_sector.driver_code = 'NOR' AND fct_lap_sector.status = 'purple';

records.question: Which circuit has the lowest median green-flag pit loss, counting only circuits marked reliable? Give the circuit name.
records.sql: SELECT circuit_name FROM fct_circuit_pit_loss WHERE is_reliable = TRUE ORDER BY median_pit_loss_s ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the median green-flag pit loss at Monaco, in seconds?
records.sql: SELECT median_pit_loss_s FROM fct_circuit_pit_loss WHERE circuit_name ILIKE '%Monaco%'

records.question: Which 2024 Grand Prix race had the lowest average track temperature? Give the event name.
records.sql: SELECT event FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2024 AND session_code = 'R' ORDER BY (SELECT avg_track_temp FROM fct_session_weather WHERE fct_session_weather.session_key = dim_session.session_key) ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: In how many 2025 Grand Prix races did it rain at some point?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fct_session_weather WHERE year = 2025 AND session_code = 'R' AND any_rain = TRUE;

records.question: In how many 2025 Grand Prix races was there at least one safety car period (not counting virtual safety cars)?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS safety_car_races FROM fct_race_control_period WHERE year = 2025 AND kind = 'SC';

records.question: Which 2023 Grand Prix races had a red flag? Give the event names.
records.sql: SELECT DISTINCT event FROM dim_session WHERE year = 2023 AND session_code = 'R' AND session_key IN (SELECT session_key FROM fct_race_control_period WHERE kind = 'RED');

records.question: How many sessions were loaded in 2025?
records.sql: SELECT sessions_loaded FROM fct_ingest_summary WHERE year = 2025;

records.question: What is the held-out mean absolute error, in places, of the pit-stop prediction for undisturbed stops?
records.sql: SELECT held_out_mae FROM fct_pit_prediction_heldout_score WHERE scope = 'undisturbed';
